name: Grade 7 IT Practice: April Week 6 - Route Planning
description: Practice words for planning and improving robot routes.

words.definition: The way from one place to another.
words.example: The path showed where the robot should travel.
The route included two turns and one checkpoint.

words.definition: A place used to check progress on a route.
words.example: The checkpoint confirmed the robot reached the middle of the maze.
The obstacle forced the robot to turn left.

words.definition: A set of steps for what to do.
words.example: The plan listed each movement before coding began.
The team improved the route after the robot hit the wall.
